chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ahmad ibn al-Walid (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar narrated to us. He said: Ahmad ibn Abu Abdillah al-Barqi narrated to us, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from Abu Ayyub al-Khazzaz, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Ali (peace be upon them), who said:

Instruct our Shia to perform the visitation (ziyara) of al-Husayn ibn Ali (peace be upon them both), for indeed his visitation repels destruction, drowning, burning, and being preyed upon by wild beasts. And his visitation is made incumbent upon whoever acknowledges the Imamate of al-Husayn as being from God, Mighty and Majestic.

key_terms.الإمامة: Imamate -- the divinely-appointed leadership of the Muslim community
key_terms.زيارة: Ziyara -- visitation, pilgrimage to the shrines of the Prophet and his family

ai.seo_question: Is visiting the shrine of Imam Husayn obligatory in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (AS) commands the faithful to encourage the Shia to visit the grave of Imam Husayn (AS). He explains two dimensions of ziyara: first, its protective power against calamities such as collapse, drowning, fire, and wild animals; second, its obligatory status for anyone who believes in the divinely-appointed Imamate of Imam Husayn. This hadith was narrated during the early centuries when authorities actively discouraged visitation to Karbala, making the Imam's emphasis on its obligation all the more significant.

en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. al-Hasan b. Ahmad b. al-Walid (ra) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. al-Hasan al-Saffar narrated to us. He said: Ahmad b. Abu `Abdillah al-Barqi narrated to us from al-Hasan b. `Ali b. Faddal from Abu Ayyub al Khazzaz from Muhammad b. Muslim from Abu Ja`far Muhammad b. `Ali (as). He said:

Instruct our Shi`a with the ziyara of al-Husayn, for surely his ziyara repels destruction and drowning and burning and being preyed upon by the predatory beasts. And his ziyara is made incumbent upon the one who confesses to the Imamate of al-Husayn as being from Allah.
